title: Resourceful Bees Nest Biome Modifier
description: Schema reconstructed from BeeNestBiomeModifier, Biome.LIST_CODEC, PlacedFeature.LIST_CODEC, RegistryCodecs, and HolderSetCodec.

biomes.description: Required biome holder set. May be a single biome ID, biome tag, list of biome IDs, or NeoForge custom holder-set object.

features.description: Required placed-feature holder set. May be a single placed-feature ID, placed-feature tag, list of placed-feature IDs, or NeoForge custom holder-set object.

customHolderSet.description: NeoForge custom holder-set dispatch object. Its additional fields depend on the registered holder-set type.

placedFeatureHolderSet.description: PlacedFeature.LIST_CODEC also has an inline direct-value branch through PlacedFeature.DIRECT_CODEC. This schema intentionally models normal datapack registry-reference authoring plus NeoForge custom holder sets, rather than guessing ConfiguredFeature/PlacementModifier internals.
